scope.publicMothStrategy: Use a reviewed, versioned allowlist of moth families and superfamilies before public launch; do not describe all Lepidoptera as moths.

hosting.reason: A request-driven edge cache keeps browser count from multiplying iNaturalist traffic and supports stale fallback without an always-on server.

live.maxActiveMothsNote: Lowered from 50 after a real abundant-data review: 50 concurrent moths lasting only 4-10s each meant species cards flew by too fast to read. 10 is a legibility choice, sized together with targetSampleSize below so an abundant window's backlog still drains in roughly the intended cycle time.
live.targetSampleSizeNote: Replaces the old maxQueuedObservations overflow cap. Derived from maxActiveMoths/averageDurationSeconds (10/14 ≈ 0.71 admissions/sec sustainable) × a ~60s target cycle ≈ 43, plus a small buffer. Selection is species-diversity-aware (round-robin across distinct species, see selectDiverseSample in observation-queue.js), not oldest-first truncation, so one common species can't crowd out everything else in an abundant window.
live.durationNote: Doubled from 4-10s (avg 7s → 14s) for the same legibility reason as maxActiveMoths above.
live.sourceTimeScaleNote: 1/1440: compresses the ~24h created_at window fetchAllObservationsInWindow now fetches in full into about one minute of animation time, rather than 1:1 real-time pace.
live.hoverBehavior: freezes the whole scene at the instant focus began (canvas or side-panel card), resuming once focus clears — see app.js's currentSceneSeconds()/currentRenderTimestamp()

sparseWindowWidening.note: Worker-side (worker/src/index.js): if the default 24h window returns fewer than sparseObservationThreshold observations, retries with a 7-day window and uses it if it actually returns more. Never fires for the UK's current volume; exists for a future lower-volume place_id.
